title: Anisotropy follows the device’s tier instead of a number in each file
summary: Thirteen textures (the Dickansh posters, the office’s windows, the project cartridges, Mario’s painted maps, the galaxy surfaces’ scans) each picked their own anisotropy. They now take the device’s: 16 on a desktop, 4 on a phone, 1 on a weak one, so a floor seen at a slant stays sharp a few metres out. Nothing to see in these software-rendered pictures; the difference shows on a real graphics chip.

measured.note: Hardcoded anisotropy sites 15 → 2 (the two deliberate skies). Bundle unchanged.
